items.title: Your style on iPhone too
items.body: Monkey coach, Quest map or Level bar: pick it in Account → Style. Your Apple Watch follows the same pick, so both look alike.

items.title: XP, levels and badges
items.body: Every workout earns XP, and hitting your weekly goal opens a chest worth 200 more. Same level and badges on iPhone and Watch.

items.title: Celebrate every finish
items.body: Your monkey dances, the stage clears or the level bar fills when you finish a workout, with any new badge right there.
